params.name: chainid
params.description: Numeric chain ID. Use 42161 for Arbitrum One. Other Arbitrum networks: 42170 (Arbitrum Nova), 421614 (Arbitrum Sepolia testnet).

params.name: module
params.description: API module name. One of: account, contract, transaction, block, logs, token, gastracker, stats.

params.name: action
params.description: Action within the selected module. See module-specific documentation for available actions.

params.name: address
params.description: Arbitrum One address (checksummed or lowercase) for account or token operations.

params.name: contractaddress
params.description: Smart contract or token contract address.

params.name: txhash
params.description: Transaction hash for transaction-specific queries.

params.name: blockno
params.description: Block number for block-specific queries.

params.name: startblock
params.description: Starting block number for range queries (default 0).

params.name: endblock
params.description: Ending block number for range queries (default 99999999).

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results (default 1).

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results per page (max 10000, default 10).

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order for results.

params.name: tag
params.description: Block tag (latest, earliest, pending) or hex block number for balance queries.

params.name: topic0
params.description: Keccak-256 hash of the event signature for log filtering.

params.name: topic1
params.description: Second event topic for log filtering.

params.name: topic0_1_opr
params.description: Operator between topic0 and topic1 (and or or).

params.name: fromBlock
params.description: Starting block for log queries.

params.name: toBlock
params.description: Ending block for log queries.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Unix timestamp for block-by-timestamp queries.

params.name: closest
params.description: Direction to find closest block to timestamp (before or after).

params.name: boolean
params.description: Boolean value for proxy-verification queries (true or false).

params.name: apikey
params.description: Your Etherscan/Arbiscan API key from https://arbiscan.io/myapikey

items.docs: All Arbiscan API calls are issued against the Etherscan V2 unified endpoint. Set chainid=42161 for Arbitrum One. The module and action parameters select the operation. An API key is required for all calls.
